play.comments: The Secret Lab, another in the line of Exit: The Game series. This was a game played with wife. We did not do well and took time and clues. Completed it, but the game gave us a rating of only 4 stars from 10! Must admit, there is one dick move the game makes which is a tad unfair and had us looking down the wrong path for a while. Still fun.
